title: A global section vanishing everywhere on a quasi-compact scheme is nilpotent
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $h\in H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)$. If the germ of $h$ is zero in every stalk of $\mathcal O_X$, then $h$ is nilpotent.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 37.53.4 (Tag 03GY), surjectivity paragraph; the underlying fact is the quasi-compactness criterion for a section vanishing at every point
